statusHint.Taken: a repository's agent has accepted it
statusHint.Submitted: its agent made its work ready — it closes at its workflow's end, once nothing holds it
statusHint.Unfinished: closed done, but it departed from what you required, so part of the work is left: it stays here until it is finished or you close its ask
statusHint.Declined: turned down — the note is the part the asker can act on
